definitions.explanation: The weekend of the current week — normally the Saturday and Sunday just ahead, and sometimes Friday evening as well. Used adverbially without a particle as often as it is used as a plain noun.

examples.japanese: {今週末|こんしゅうまつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧です。
{今週末|こんしゅうまつ}、⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きません→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like to go see a movie this weekend?

examples.japanese: {今週末|こんしゅうまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{決|き}まっていない→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: My plans for this weekend aren't settled yet, so I'll get in touch tomorrow.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{今|こん}→今〜：03952_kon⟧ (this) + ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧ (weekend). Like other time words of this shape, it takes no particle when used adverbially: {今週末|こんしゅうまつ}⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧, not ×{今週末|こんしゅうまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今週末|こんしゅうまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: plans for this weekend
- {今週末|こんしゅうまつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: by this weekend
- {今週末|こんしゅうまつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空|あ}いています→空く：11062_aku⟧: I'm free this weekend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {来週末|らいしゅうまつ}: next weekend
- {先週末|せんしゅうまつ}: last weekend
- ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧: weekend — no anchoring to a particular week
